persona.role: E1 Creative Designer & Retail UX Strategist
persona.archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Tactical Retail & High-Velocity Supermarket POS)
persona.tone: Professional, high-precision, executive clarity with energetic action states
principles: Fusion over Imitation: High-density tactical dashboard mixed with crisp modern POS ergonomics
Emotion First: Operational confidence, speed under pressure, real-time control for cashiers and managers
Content is King: Data-first layout, exception-based alerts, instantly scannable cash register & inventory metrics
Tactical Contrast: High visibility contrast for dark/light themes, clear role-based UI states (Admin/Manager/Cashier)

typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans, sans-serif
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-black tracking-tight uppercase
hierarchy.kpi_value: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tighter tabular-nums

layout_strategy.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6)
layout_strategy.pos_layout: Split-pane: Left section (70% width) for barcode search, product catalog grid, category filters; Right section (30% width) sticky cart summary, cash input, payment method, tax/discount calculation, and process payment CTA
layout_strategy.cash_register_layout: Two-column ledger: Left panel for session status (apertura/cierre, balance inicial, ventas acumuladas), Right panel for cash movements list (ingresos, retiros, arqueo de caja con diferencia)
layout_strategy.navigation: Top navigation bar with Max Power logo, real-time date/clock, active store branch indicator, active role badge (Administrador / Gerente / Cajero), search bar, live system alerts indicator, theme toggle, and user profile with Google login/logout action

access: Gestión de Productos e Inventarios CRUD
Gestión de Usuarios y Roles (Crear, Editar, Permisos)
Gestión de Productos e Inventarios (Lectura/Edición de stock)

modules.name: Auth / Google Login
features: Google Sign-In simulation / OAuth toggle
Quick role switchers for testing: Administrador (Carlos Admin), Gerente (María Gerente), Cajero (Juan Cajero)
Security status indicator and simulated JWT session token store

modules.name: Executive Dashboard
features: Real-time KPIs: Ingresos Hoy ($), Ventas totales, Ticket Promedio ($), Alertas activas de caja/stock
Interactive Charts: Sales by hour/day (Recharts area/bar), Payment method breakdown (Pie/Donut)
Quick alert ticker for stockout warnings and cash threshold alerts
Role-filtered metrics (Admin sees company totals, Cajero sees shift totals)

modules.name: Point of Sale (POS Supermercado)
features: Product barcode scanner / search input + category quick tabs (Abarrotes, Lácteos, Bebidas, Enlatados, Limpieza)
Visual grid of fast-sale items with stock count badge and price tag
Interactive Cart with quantity increment/decrement, line-item discounts, clear cart
Payment modal supporting Cash (Efectivo with change calculation), Card (Tarjeta), Transfer (Transferencia)
Ticket generation / Printable receipt preview popup upon checkout finish

modules.name: Caja & Movimientos (Supermercado Cash Register)
features: Active session status header: State (Abierta / Cerrada), Opened at, Initial Cash (Monto Inicial)
Apertura de caja modal (Set initial float, cashier name, notes)
Movimientos de caja form (Ingreso extra, Retiro de efectivo, Pago a proveedor)
Cierre de caja & Arqueo modal (Counted cash input vs System calculated cash = Discrepancy calculation in real-time)
Historical cash sessions log table

modules.name: Inventario & Productos
features: Product data table with barcode, name, category, cost price, sale price, current stock, low-stock threshold, status badge
Create / Edit Product dialog with price margin auto-calculation
Stock adjustment modal (Add stock, stock adjustment with reason)
Low stock highlight filter button

modules.name: Historial de Ventas
features: Filterable sales table by date range, cashier, payment method, status (Completada, Anulada)
Sale details drawer showing itemized breakdown, tax total, receipt ID, and cashier signature
Export to CSV/Excel button simulation
Annul transaction option (Admin/Manager only with authorization modal)

modules.name: Gestión de Usuarios y Permisos
features: User list table with avatar, name, email, role badge, last login date, active toggle
Role permission matrix visualization (Permissions breakdown for Admin, Manager, Cashier)
Create / Edit user dialog with Google account linking capability

modules.name: Centro de Alertas
features: Stock bajo alerts (Product stock <= minimum threshold)
Caja alert (Cash box exceeding max limit requiring cash drop, or discrepancy at closing)
Actionable resolution buttons ('Reorganizar Inventario', 'Registrar Retiro de Caja', 'Marcar Resuelto')

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components are written in clean JavaScript (.js / .jsx).
Add 'data-testid' to EVERY button, input, tab, card, modal, and table row (e.g., data-testid='pos-add-product-btn', data-testid='caja-apertura-submit', data-testid='kpi-ingresos-card').
Use Lucide-React icons extensively for retail items, currency, checkouts, and alerts.
Implement Sonner toast notifications for cashier checkout success, inventory updates, caja opening/closing, and authorization errors.
Persist sample seeded data (Products, Sales, Cash Sessions, System Alerts, Users) in local state or browser localStorage so all actions feel dynamic, real, and interactive.
Support active role switching directly from header or profile dropdown so the reviewer can instantly test how Cajero view differs from Administrador/Gerente.
Keep typography tight with Barlow Condensed for numbers & titles, plus clean technical styling for tabular data.
All interactive UI text MUST be in Spanish.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: Never use fully transparent header or dropdown backgrounds. Use backdrop-blur-xl with crisp solid or dark glass surfaces.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_mandatory: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.responsive_mobile: POS layout collapses into tabs on small viewports while maintaining high-density tabular visibility on desktop.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toast_engine: Use sonner for instant feedback on cash operations, low stock alerts, and role authorization blocks.
